fomod.Name: Horizon UI
fomod.Author: moragar
fomod.Description: Horizon UI is an adaptive, dynamic, customizable and modular HUD for Starfield: translucent cards in Exo 2 with a configurable accent, set up live in game with F11. Requires Starfield 1.16.244 and SFSE (launch with sfse_loader.exe). Loose files: add bInvalidateOlderFiles=1 (and sResourceDataDirsFinal=) under [Archive] in Documents\My Games\Starfield\StarfieldCustom.ini. Credits: Exo 2 by Natanael Gama, SIL OFL 1.1; Roboto by Christian Robertson (with ParaType and Font Bureau), SIL OFL 1.1. Horizon Comms replaces other subtitles and dialogue menu mods. Install one or the other for each menu. Use Skip Horizon dialogue to keep another dialogue mod. Your settings are kept in HorizonUI.user.ini and are never overwritten by updates. Not compatible with other mods that replace the HUD (hudmenu.gfx). Disable them before using Horizon's HUD. The optional Quick Menu (Favorites) module replaces the quick menu (favoritesmenu.swf and favoritesmenu_lrg.swf). Untick it to keep the game's quick menu or another mod's.
